sentences.text: Guru seni yang hadir dulu pernah mengajari mereka mengukir gagang belati dari kayu.
sentences.en: The art teacher who attended once taught them to carve a wooden dagger handle.
sentences.ko: 참석한 미술 선생님은 예전에 그들에게 나무로 단검 손잡이 깎는 법을 가르쳤어요.

sentences.text: Novel yang dibaca Budi bercerita tentang preman pasar yang berubah menjadi guru.
sentences.en: The novel Budi is reading is about a market thug who becomes a teacher.
sentences.ko: 부디가 읽는 소설은 시장 깡패가 선생님이 되는 이야기예요.

sentences.text: Ternyata anak yang dulu dijuluki preman kelas kini menjadi guru agama.
sentences.en: It turned out the boy once nicknamed the class thug is now a religion teacher.
sentences.ko: 예전에 반 깡패로 불리던 아이가 알고 보니 지금은 종교 선생님이 됐어요.

sentences.text: Kakak kelas memberi Budi tip agar tidak gugup saat presentasi.
sentences.en: A senior gave Budi tips on not getting nervous during presentations.
sentences.ko: 선배가 부디에게 발표할 때 긴장하지 않는 요령을 알려 줬어요.

sentences.text: Siti memberi tip besar kepada pelayan yang sudah membantu sampai malam.
sentences.en: Siti gave a big tip to the waiters who had helped until late.
sentences.ko: 시티는 밤늦게까지 도와준 종업원들에게 팁을 넉넉히 줬어요.

sentences.text: Anak-anak suka bercerita tentang arwah penunggu gedung sekolah tua.
sentences.en: The children love telling stories about the spirit said to haunt the old school building.
sentences.ko: 아이들은 오래된 학교 건물에 산다는 귀신 이야기를 즐겨 해요.

sentences.text: Sebelum makan, para alumni berdoa untuk arwah teman yang sudah tiada.
sentences.en: Before eating, the alumni prayed for the soul of a friend who had passed away.
sentences.ko: 식사 전에 동문들은 세상을 떠난 친구의 영혼을 위해 기도했어요.
